A bipartite graph with no 4-cycles is called a "C4-free bipartite graph." The Zarankiewicz problem asks for the maximum edges in such graphs.

For a bipartite graph with parts of size m and n, avoiding C4, the maximum edges is roughly O(n^(3/2)).
